children: Shares of Boost Run were higher after the company said it expects to be added to the Russell 2000 and Russell 3000 indexes.
The stock gained 13% to $17.08, and is up 35% this year.
The cloud computing company said it expects to be added to both indexes after the market closes Friday.

"Our inclusion in the Russell 2000 and Russell 3000 Indexes marks an important milestone for Boost Run and reflects the foundation we have built as we continue to scale the business," Chief Executive Andrew Karos said.
